learningObjectives: Differentiate training, validation, and testing datasets
Explain how models learn patterns from training data
Identify overfitting and underfitting using model behavior

activities.title: Dataset Split Map
activities.instruction: Arrange data into training, validation, and test sets.

content.concept: Dataset splitting separates model learning, tuning, and final evaluation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Model Learning Flow
activities.instruction: Explore how data moves through model training.

content.concept: A model learns parameters from training examples and uses them to make predictions on unseen data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Overfit or Underfit
activities.instruction: Select the behavior represented by each model.

content.concept: Overfitting occurs when a model learns training details too closely, while underfitting fails to capture useful patterns.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Model Complexity Slider
activities.instruction: Adjust complexity and observe how model fit changes.

content.concept: Increasing model complexity can improve fit but may also increase the risk of overfitting.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
